handoffs.message: Implementation complete. 5 files created in services/broker/shioaji/. 27 tests pass (python3 -m pytest test_adapter.py -v). Commit: e81146b8. Key invariants: BROKER_SHIOAJI_SANDBOX_ENABLED=false by default (fail-closed); live orders always SHIOAJI_LIVE_DISABLED regardless of gate; SDK import lazy with ImportError fallback; ShioajiOrder shape mirrors PaperOrder. Please review adapter.py interface, gate enforcement, and test coverage.

Review requires changes: gate/live reject coverage passed and python3 -m pytest services/broker/shioaji/test_adapter.py -v passed (27 passed), but submit() accepts fractional qty while _place_order_via_sdk() sends quantity=int(qty), silently truncating sandbox order size (for example 1.9 -> 1, 0.5 -> 0) while README documents integer lots. Reject non-integer qty before SDK calls with an explicit error and add a focused test for fractional qty rejection, then hand back to Codex2 for review.

Fixed fractional qty truncation: added INVALID_QTY rejection for non-integer qty in submit() before any SDK call (qty != int(qty) check), with message 'fractional quantities are not supported'. Added TestFractionalQtyRejection (5 tests: 1.9, 0.5, 1.5 rejected; 2.0/5.0 accepted; place_order not called on fractional). 32 tests pass. Commit ce7199eb.

Review approved by Codex2. Verified Shioaji sandbox adapter fail-closed/live-disabled gating, fractional qty rejection before SDK calls, and focused test suite: python3 -m pytest services/broker/shioaji/test_adapter.py -v (32 passed); git diff --check HEAD~2..HEAD -- services/broker/shioaji; python3 -m compileall -q services/broker/shioaji. Owner Claude should perform closeout finalization.
